name: SRU Steels Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, SRU Steels Ltd is engaged in the business of Trading of Stainless Steel.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SRUSL is in the business of various types of steels, including stainless steels, mild steels, and carbon iron steel, and acts as a consignment agent. The company is mainly operative in the city of Delhi and does not operate in any other place.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.43 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 0.89% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 63.2 to 104 days.
Working capital days have increased from 433 days to 727 days
